storage: Keep in a dry airtight jar at room temperature away from heat and moisture; use a dry spoon. Refrigeration is not needed but a cool place helps.
looksLike: Fine off-white to pale cream powder that clumps if damp; it dissolves in water to give milk.
howToPick: Read the label for "whole milk powder" or "full cream" and the fat percentage (about 26% fat); avoid products called "dairy whitener" or "creamer". Free-flowing powder, no hard lumps, no stale or rancid smell, sealed pouch.
shelfLife: Unopened pouches usually carry a long best-before (months); once opened, use within a few weeks (general guidance, not from a source in this run). Stored powders can build oxidised cholesterol, so do not keep it for long.
substitutes: Instant or skimmed milk powder plus a little ghee

usedIn.raw: 30 g per serving (about 3½ tbsp, mixed into the dough)
